key_insight: GeoDiv KAN combines geometry-aware feature gating with built-in incompressibility to solve time-fractional Navier–Stokes equations on complex domains.
engineering_relevance: The approach targets geometry-sensitive flow prediction and CFD reconstruction, with applications to cylinder wakes and turbulent U-bend flows.
method: Gaussian radial basis function Kolmogorov–Arnold network.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports higher predictive accuracy than PINN, PIKAN, RBF KAN, and DF RBFKAN on square, circular, and star-shaped benchmarks, plus applications to two public CFD datasets.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify accuracy gains, computational cost, or generalization to unseen geometries and flow regimes.
paper_title: GeoDiv KAN Solver for Time Fractional Navier Stokes Equations on Complex Domains to Realistic CFD Reconstruction
